content:
The screen sizes of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will remain the same as the previous generation, but rumors suggest both models will see upgrades in two other areas. What are the new features? Let's tell you right away.

First: LTPO+ technology

LTPO is the technology that has long powered the iPhone's "Always-On Display" and ProMotion screen features. There are reports that the iPhone 18 Pro will upgrade to the more advanced LTPO+.

The benefits of LTPO+ include: more responsive adjustments that can reduce screen flickering in dim environments while also being more power-efficient. This means iPhone 18 Pro users can enjoy more stable screen performance with lower power consumption.

Second: Smaller Dynamic Island cutout

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to feature a smaller Dynamic Island cutout on their screens, meaning the actual usable screen area will increase slightly.

The new Dynamic Island is rumored to be approximately 35% smaller than the version on the iPhone 17 Pro. The new Siri design in iOS 27 seems to have already hinted at this size.

Apple first introduced the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 14 Pro in 2022. Although software features related to the Dynamic Island and "Live Activities" have grown richer over the years, the physical cutout itself has never changed.

With the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple has finally taken a step toward the dream of a "zero-cutout" screen.

What other changes would you like to see on future iPhone screens? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
